info.name: Gets active car listings for the given search criteria

params.name: api_key
params.description: The API Authentication Key. Mandatory with all API calls.

params.name: latitude
params.description: Latitude component of location

params.name: longitude
params.description: Longitude component of location

params.name: radius
params.description: Radius around the search location

params.name: car_type
params.description: Car type. Allowed values are: new / used / certified

params.name: seller_type
params.description: Seller type to filter cars on. You can pass in multiple seller type values comma separated.

params.name: year
params.description: Car year - 1980 onwards. You can pass in multiple year values comma separated.

params.name: make
params.description: Car Make - should be a standard OEM Make name. You can pass in multiple make values separated by comma. e.g. ford,audi

params.name: model
params.description: Car model to search. You can pass in multiple model values comma separated for e.g f-150,Mustang.

params.name: trim
params.description: Car trim to search. You can pass in multiple trim values comma separated.

params.name: dealer_id
params.description: Dealer id to filter the cars.

params.name: vin
params.description: Car vin to search

params.name: source
params.description: Source to search cars. You can pass in multiple source values comma separated.

params.name: body_type
params.description: Body type to filter the cars on. You can pass in multiple body types comma separated.

params.name: body_subtype
params.description: Body subtype to filter the cars on. You can pass in multiple body subtype values comma separated.

params.name: vehicle_type
params.description: Vehicle type to filter the cars on. You can pass in multiple vehicle type values comma separated.

params.name: vins
params.description: Comma separated list of 17 digit vins to search the matching cars for. Only 10 VINs allowed per request.

params.name: taxonomy_vins
params.description: Comma separated list of 10 letter taxonomy VINs (first 8 + 10th + 11th chars of 17-digit VIN).

params.name: ymmt
params.description: Comma separated list of Year|Make|Model|Trim combinations. e.g. 2010|Audi|A5,2014|Nissan|Sentra|S 6MT

params.name: match
params.description: Comma separated list of fields for exact matching (year,make,model,trim).

params.name: cylinders
params.description: Cylinders to filter the cars on. You can pass in multiple cylinder values comma separated.

params.name: transmission
params.description: Transmission to filter the cars on. [a = Automatic, m = Manual].

params.name: speeds
params.description: Speeds to filter the cars on. You can pass in multiple speeds values comma separated.

params.name: doors
params.description: Doors to filter the cars on. You can pass in multiple doors values comma separated.

params.name: drivetrain
params.description: Drivetrain to filter the cars on. You can pass in multiple drivetrain values comma separated.

params.name: exterior_color
params.description: Exterior color to match. You can pass in multiple exterior color values comma separated.

params.name: interior_color
params.description: Interior color to match. You can pass in multiple interior color values comma separated.

params.name: engine
params.description: Filter listings on engine

params.name: engine_type
params.description: Engine Type to match. You can pass in multiple engine type values comma separated.

params.name: engine_aspiration
params.description: Engine Aspiration to match. You can pass in multiple Engine aspiration values comma separated.

params.name: engine_block
params.description: Engine Block to match. You can pass in multiple Engine Block values comma separated.

params.name: miles_range
params.description: Miles range to filter cars with miles in the given range. Range to be given in the format: min-max e.g. 1000-5000

params.name: price_range
params.description: Price range to filter cars with the price in the range given. Range to be given in the format: min-max e.g. 1000-5000

params.name: dom_range
params.description: Days on Market range to filter cars with the DOM within the given range. Range to be given in the format: min-max e.g. 10-50

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Sort by field - allowed fields are distance|price|miles|dom|age|posted_at|year. Default sort field is distance from the given point.

params.name: sort_order
params.description: Sort order - asc or desc. Default sort order is distance from a point.

params.name: rows
params.description: Number of results to return. Default is 10. Max is 50.

params.name: start
params.description: Page number to fetch the results for the given criteria. Default is 1. Pagination is allowed only till first 1000 results.

params.name: facets
params.description: The comma separated list of fields for which facets are requested. Supported fields are - year, make, model, trim, vehicle_type, car_type, body_type, body_subtype, drivetrain, cylinders, transmission, exterior_color, interior_color, doors, engine_type, engine_aspiration, engine_block.

params.name: stats
params.description: The list of fields for which stats need to be generated. Allowed fields are - price, miles, msrp, dom.

params.name: country
params.description: Filter on Country, by default US. Search available on US (United States) and CA (Canada).

params.name: plot
params.description: If plot has value true results in around 25k coordinates with limited fields to plot respective graph.

params.name: nodedup
params.description: If nodedup is set to true then will give results using is_searchable.

params.name: state
params.description: Filter listings on State.

params.name: city
params.description: Filter listings on city.

params.name: dealer_name
params.description: Filter listings on dealer_name.

params.name: trim_o
params.description: Filter listings on web scraped trim.

params.name: trim_r
params.description: Filter trim on custom possible matches.

params.name: dom_active_range
params.description: Active Days on Market range to filter cars. Range to be given in the format: min-max e.g. 10-50

params.name: dom_180_range
params.description: Last 180 Days on Market range to filter cars. Range to be given in the format: min-max e.g. 10-50

params.name: options
params.description: Tokenizer search on options. For multiple options use | as separator.

params.name: features
params.description: Tokenizer search on features. For multiple options use | as separator.

items.docs: This endpoint is the meat of the API and serves many purposes. This API produces a list of currently active cars from the market for the given search criteria. The API results are limited to allow pagination upto 1000 rows. The search API facilitates the following use cases - 1. Search Cars around a given geo-point within a given radius 2. Search cars for a specific year / make / model or combination of these 3. Search cars matching multiple year, make, model combinations in the same search requ
